text.p: PRAVDA - Slovakia's sole oil refiner Slovnaft has asked the finance ministry to increase the maximum petrol price by 0.50 crowns a litre from August 1.

NARODNA OBRODA - Financial damage caused by recent flooding and heavy rains to state property are estimated at around 1.4 billion crowns. The worst hit was the agricultural sector with damage totalling some 974.3 million crowns.

- The Slovak Jewish community said the gold and precious stones the Czech Republic recently agreed to return to Slovakia should not go to the Slovak governemnt since it belonged to Slovak Jews killed in World War Two.
- Local money market dealers expect the finance ministry to continue accepting high yields in state securities auctions this week, predicting average yields at around 18 percent.
SME - Volkswagen's Bratislava plant should get unspecified tax relief for tenchnology imports, expected effective from the beginning of 1998.
- The Confederation of Trade Unions (KOZ) said the govrenment was fully responsible for Slovakia's failure to be invitated to be among the first-wave countries in NATO and EU enlargement.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Heavy rain and flooding in the past month have delayed the grain harvest. Only around one tenth of expected grain production has been harvested so far.
